brief:
A Palestinian man from Bethlehem has issued a humanitarian appeal to donors, officials and charitable organisations for assistance, the Palestine News Network reported. He is struggling with severe health and financial challenges while caring for his three children who have special needs.

The appeal underscores the mounting pressures facing families across the West Bank who care for children with disabilities. Access to healthcare services and social support remains limited in the region, leaving many families dependent on charitable aid and community assistance to meet their children's needs.

title: Bethlehem father seeks aid for three children with special needs
